criteria.text: Explicit lint advises when a copy with at least three fields differs from a shared record with at least four fields by constraints or one extra or missing field.
Changing a nested constraint is visible even when the field names stay the same.
Equal copies and schemas differing by two fields produce no drift advice.
Ambiguous matches warn without choosing a record.
Drift advice leaves the server lint result and exit status unchanged.
Empty, one-field and two-field inline schemas are skipped; an equal three-field record can match exactly, but a differing three-field record gives no near advice.
Reordering required fields or enum alternatives gives no drift advice; changing the order inside literal array values still does.

cases.given: synthetic canonical properties name,run_id,kind,active; copies name,kind,active (3), all four (4) with changed name constraint, and all four plus age (5)
cases.required_observation: all three advise with consumer, canonical target and exact difference; empty/one/two-field schemas stay untouched

cases.given: Use four eligible synthetic fields count,name,kind,active with identical fillers; same fields; nested count.minimum is 0 in copy and 1 in record
semantic equal with different key order/title; field symmetric difference 2; literal $contract in default
cases.required_observation: no drift advice for any of these

cases.given: two different records equally near the inline copy
cases.required_observation: ambiguous warning; no arbitrary selected reference

cases.given: fake server lint passes then refuses in separate runs; drift advice in both
cases.required_observation: exit 0 then 4 follows server result; same upload/request semantics; no checks or expected-value writes

cases.given: Use four eligible synthetic fields count,name,kind,active with identical fillers; one record and inline copies with identical fields and constraints except nested count.minimum uses 1, 1.0 or 1e0; repeat with 0, -0, 0.0 and 0e0
cases.required_observation: each copy selects the unique record as an exact match with no differences or drift advice

cases.given: Use four eligible synthetic fields count,name,kind,active with identical fillers; same fields; nested count.minimum is the exact JSON token 9007199254740993 in copy and 9007199254740992 in the only record
cases.required_observation: near match and drift advice identify the nested minimum difference with both exact values; no exact match despite binary rounding

cases.given: Use four eligible synthetic fields count,name,kind,active with identical fillers; two records with different canonical targets and identical fields and constraints except nested count.minimum uses 1 and 1.0; inline copy uses 1e0
cases.required_observation: both records are semantically exact candidates; ambiguous warning and no selected match or arbitrary reference

first three skipped entirely; with otherwise equal constraints, three-field missing copy is near, equal four-field copy is exact, five-field extra copy is near; canonical three with equal three-field copy matches exact, differing constraint or missing/extra field never near-matches

cases.given: four-field record required [name,run_id,kind,active], enum [open,closed]; copy reverses required and enum only
cases.required_observation: exact match, no differences or advice

cases.given: four-field object schema whose array-typed property has enum alternatives [[1,2],[3,4]]; reordered alternatives are equal, [2,1] replacing [1,2] differs; repeat ordered arrays in default/examples/const including literal objects named required and enum
cases.required_observation: only outer schema required/enum order is ignored; every changed literal array order produces a constraint difference

cases.given: four-field synthetic valid canonical schema; copy duplicates one required name or enum alternative instead of merely reordering; separately reorder the same duplicate multiset on both sides
cases.required_observation: comparison ignores order only; changed multiplicity differs, same multiplicities compare equally; preflight retains its independent invalid-schema handling
